# Quill CLI

A lightweight link checker for Markdown files.

## Requirements

- Python 3.10 or higher

## Quick Example

```sh
$ quill check notes.md
```

## Behavior Summary

Passing a file such as `notes.md` to `quill check` scans the document's links and reports any broken targets. This makes it straightforward to wire into CI pipelines, because findings cause the command to exit with code `1`.

## Exit Codes

| Code | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | All checked links passed |
| `1` | Findings reported (one or more broken links) |
| Other non-zero | Command failed to run properly |

# Quill

CLI for reporting broken links in Markdown documents.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.10

## Usage Example

```sh
quill check notes.md
```

## Behavior Summary

`quill check notes.md` requires Python 3.10. It inspects `notes.md` for broken links and reports any findings. Broken-link findings trigger exit code `1`, a clean check exits with `0`, and other errors produce another non-zero exit status.

## Exit Status Notes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | Success; no broken links found |
| `1` | Findings; broken links reported |
| Other non-zero | Command failed due to another error |
